canon.note: Basic Frigid Cold Arrow (100101) Ice DMG = 100% of ATK at Lv6 (L10 = 140%), single hit. Skill (100102) grants a shield: amount = #1 57% of DEF + #4 760 flat at L10 (= 1179 at DEF 735), lasting #2 = 3 turns (+1 from the Reinforce trace). Ultimate Glacial Cascade (100103) Ice DMG #1 L10 = 150% of ATK to all enemies; #2 = 50% base Freeze chance (+15% from the Ice Spell trace = 65%); Frozen targets take Ice Additional DMG #4 = 60% of March's ATK at the start of their turn. Talent Girl Power (100104): after an ally with a shield is attacked, March launches a counter dealing #1 L10 = 100% of ATK, up to #2 = 2 counters per turn. Energy limit 110.

fixtures.env: March 7th E0 solo vs 3 Ice-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7 — enemy attacks trigger shields and counters

requirements.claim: Talent Girl Power: a Shielded ally who is attacked counters immediately (preservation.ts:137-152, logged 'March Talent: Girl Power (counter +10 Energy)').
Basic ATK Frigid Cold Arrow (100101, Ice) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.
The shield Skill (100102) is March 7th's Skill action; the fixture casts it 3 times.
Glacial Cascade (100103) is March 7th's Ultimate action; cast twice.
March 7th's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; never a generic attack action.
Glacial Cascade is an AoE Ultimate: 2 casts x 3 targets x 4 hits = 24 damage events.
Glacial Cascade #1 = 150% of ATK at L10 (100103), delivered per target as 4 hits of 0.375 each (4 x 0.375 = 1.5).
Frigid Cold Arrow (100101) totals 100% of ATK at the engine's default Basic Lv6 (canon Lv6 ladder = 100%), single hit.
Girl Power counters trigger 6 times over the fixture (capped at #2 = 2 per turn).
Girl Power (100104) counter damage #1 = 100% of ATK at L10.
The Skill's shield = #1 57% of DEF + #4 760 flat at L10 (100102): 0.57 x 735 + 760 = 1179.
The shield lasts #2 = 3 turns, +1 from the Reinforce trace = 4 turns.
Glacial Cascade's #2 = 50% base Freeze chance (+15% Ice Spell trace) lands as a hard control effect; 4 Freezes applied in this fixture.
Frozen is carried as a Freeze Damage-over-Time status (4 DOT_APPLIED events, kind Freeze).
Frozen targets take Ice Additional DMG #4 = 60% of March's ATK (100103) at the start of their turn: 0.6 x 2000 = 1200.
Each shield Skill costs 1 Skill Point; 3 Skill casts spend 3 SP.
Each Basic ATK restores 1 Skill Point; 2 Basics gain 2 SP.
Glacial Cascade uses the standard Energy ladder (110); this rotation regenerates exactly 185 Energy.
The shield buff is applied by the Skill before the first Girl Power counter resolves.
The Ultimate action starts before Glacial Cascade damage resolves.
